picks.excerpt: Unreal MCP is now available in Unreal Editor for Fortnite. UEFN evangelist Magnus Enebakk walks through Model Context Protocol in UEFN and how agentic coding tools can drive island creation directly inside the editor.
picks.rationale: A shipped editor capability, not commentary: agents can now drive UEFN scene authoring over MCP, which changes how a level is built tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: Unity ships a CLI installable in one terminal command, with a Pipeline package that 'opens the Editor to the outside world' — listing commands, managing Play mode, running tests and executing C# in a live Editor instance. The control surface external agents and scripts need.
picks.rationale: The other half of the same shift on the other engine — a real command surface that lets scripts and agents reach into a running Unity Editor.

picks.excerpt: Meta is rolling out Pocket to US users after a Brazil test: an app where anyone prompts small interactive games — 'gizmos' that respond to touch, tilt and sound — into a scrollable, remixable feed. Text-to-game creation as a consumer social format, with the acquired Gizmo app being shut down in its favour.
picks.rationale: Text-to-game leaves the demo stage and becomes a shipping consumer feed — a new distribution shape for tiny interactive work, not just a new tool.

picks.excerpt: A newly surfaced Sony patent describes an AI agent trained on your own play data that can grind or replay sections for you — and a marketplace where players could sell that behavioural data to train it. It reframes player modelling from a tuning tool into a designed, monetised game system.
picks.rationale: Turns player modelling into a designed, monetised system feature — a design question about progression and ownership, not an ethics op-ed.

picks.excerpt: Blue Archive creator Kim Yong-ha's packed BIC 2026 keynote asked how a game becomes a 'world', arguing that in the AI era the one thing only humans hold is the aesthetic judgement that decides what belongs in that world. Includes a short interview alongside the talk.
picks.rationale: A working creative director naming the craft skill that survives — aesthetic judgement over what belongs in a world — with a keynote and interview to back it.
